CFG.PROJECTS_FILTER_DESCRIPTION: Leave empty for no filter. Applies to search and backlog-import only — doesn't affect a task already imported. Separate from Default Project further down, which is where imported tasks land inside Super Productivity.
CFG.PROJECTS_EXCLUDE_DESCRIPTION: Leave empty for no filter. Applies to search and backlog-import only — doesn't affect a task already imported. A project checked here is excluded even if also checked in Projects to include.
CFG.AREAS_FILTER_DESCRIPTION: Leave empty for no filter. Applies to search and backlog-import only — doesn't affect a task already imported.
CFG.AREAS_EXCLUDE_DESCRIPTION: Leave empty for no filter. Applies to search and backlog-import only — doesn't affect a task already imported. An area checked here is excluded even if also checked in Areas to include.
CFG.STATUS_FILTER_DESCRIPTION: Leave empty to include every active status. Check just the ones you want, e.g. everything except Waiting. Applies to search and backlog-import only — doesn't affect a task already imported.
CFG.STATUS_EXCLUDE_DESCRIPTION: Leave empty for no filter. Applies to search and backlog-import only — doesn't affect a task already imported. A status checked here is excluded even if also checked in Statuses to include.
CFG.TAGS_FILTER_DESCRIPTION: Leave empty for no filter. Options are collected from your current tasks' tags, so a tag with no active tasks won't show up here yet. Applies to search and backlog-import only — doesn't affect a task already imported.
CFG.TAGS_EXCLUDE_DESCRIPTION: Leave empty for no filter. Options are collected from your current tasks' tags, so a tag with no active tasks won't show up here yet. Applies to search and backlog-import only — doesn't affect a task already imported. A tag checked here is excluded even if also checked in Tags to include.
CFG.CONTEXTS_FILTER_DESCRIPTION: Leave empty for no filter. Options are collected from your current tasks' contexts, so a context with no active tasks won't show up here yet. Applies to search and backlog-import only — doesn't affect a task already imported.
CFG.CONTEXTS_EXCLUDE_DESCRIPTION: Leave empty for no filter. Options are collected from your current tasks' contexts, so a context with no active tasks won't show up here yet. Applies to search and backlog-import only — doesn't affect a task already imported. A context checked here is excluded even if also checked in Contexts to include.
CFG.ONLY_FOCUSED_TODAY_DESCRIPTION: Off by default. When on, only tasks MindWtr has explicitly marked as focused for today are included. Applies to search and backlog-import only — doesn't affect a task already imported.
CFG.IGNORE_DUE_DATE_DESCRIPTION: Off by default. When off, a MindWtr task with a specific due time schedules the linked task directly, skipping the backlog. When on, MindWtr's due date is never applied to the linked task.
CFG.WEB_APP_URL_DESCRIPTION: When set, "Open Issue" opens this URL instead of the task's raw data endpoint. It opens the app itself, not the specific task.
CFG.DELETE_BEHAVIOR_DESCRIPTION: What happens in MindWtr when the linked task is deleted here. None: MindWtr is untouched. Archive: the task is archived in MindWtr. Delete: the task is deleted in MindWtr.

FORM_HELP:
Lists open MindWtr tasks in the task creation panel in the daily planning view, as suggestions with a link to the task and more information about it. Open tasks can also be imported automatically.

Connects to MindWtr's self-hosted Cloud Server (the /v1/* REST API), not the desktop app's local-only API — Host is the address of that server.

"Open Issue" opens the Web App URL if one is set, or the task's raw data otherwise. Either way it opens the app or data, not a link to the specific task.

Title, notes, tags, due date, time estimate and done status each sync Off, Pull, Push, or Both, set individually via the dropdown next to each field further down. All default to Pull.
